wa_bend_center_riptide.notes: FA held (MP only, never set from MP alone): Jim Matthews / Mike Lasater, June 2012. MP: anchor on top plus a second rap anchor ~90 ft down, two 60 m raps to the ground; may start from the ground below Ed's Jam or from the class 3 ramp ledge, so 1 vs 2 pitches is unclear; pitches left at 1. Rack per MP: one set of nuts, double cams to 0.75 Camalot, one #1 (rack not written: paragraph field, no prose this pass). Grade and length from MP only: theCrag returned Forbidden in Chrome; The Mountaineers' Bend page lists no routes (it does name Oak Creek Wildlife Area as land manager and a Discover Pass, consistent with WDFW); four chossclimbers Bend trip reports name none of these routes. pitches 1 kept: MP states no pitch count. Held, not written: WDFW's Oak Creek unit page bars rock climbing near nesting golden eagles from Feb 1 until nesting ends (boundary posted in the field) but names no cliff; MP marks the Bend "closed (2021) due to nesting eagles" with no end date. No official page ties a closure to this crag now, so no closure text is proposed. Parking pin held: MP says park at the gravel lot by the Quonset hut and cross the Tieton on the suspension footbridge, then walk west on the Tieton Nature Trail; which OSM lot that is (the Royal Columns lot, way 446937772, vs the WDFW "Oak Creek Wildlife Area" lot, way 446939272, ~250 m N of the cliff across the river) is an inference, so no pin is proposed.
